    level="1"
    right="Feat 6"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Crushing Step](/Feats.aspx?ID=4175) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=12" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Highhelm](/Sources.aspx?ID=204) pg. 110

**Archetype** [Stalwart Defender](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=205)

**Prerequisites**
[Stalwart Defender Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=4172)

</column>

---

The weight of your armored feet casts aside natural impediments. When wearing medium or heavy armor, you ignore [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=453) from non-magical sources. If you are a master in the armor you are wearing, you also ignore greater difficult terrain from non-magical sources.
name: Crushing Step
